envelope.description: Name head artifacts from a written title

body.title: Name head artifacts from a written title
body.summary: Add optional title to SpecArtifactBody and DefineBody and ask for it in the brainstorm and define synthesizer prompts/schemas; finalizeBrainstorm, finalizeIssue and finalizeDefine label from body.title, and finalizeStandaloneLld (when no head exists yet) from params.storyTitle, each falling back to safeDeriveSlug(focus).
acceptanceChecks: A SPEC/DEF/ISSUE with a title gets a folder slug derived from it.
Absent or degenerate titles fall back to the focus-derived slug.
Existing title-less artifacts keep their stored epicSlug.
A first-time standalone LLD is labelled from storyTitle; a re-finalized one keeps the label its existing LLD head carries.

tests.name: head naming from title with focus fallback (SPEC, DEF, ISSUE, standalone LLD)
regression guard: standalone design.story with specHash stamps seededFromSpec and renders the Seeded-from line
